gloss: feeling of solidarity; sense of unity

definitions.gloss: feeling of solidarity; sense of unity; togetherness
definitions.explanation: The shared feeling of belonging and mutual support within a group. Implies emotional bonds formed through shared experiences, goals, or hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連帯感|れんたいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: The team has a strong sense of solidarity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連帯感|れんたいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まった→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The disaster deepened the community's sense of solidarity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧ことで、⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連帯感|れんたいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: Working together toward a common goal fostered a sense of solidarity among the members.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{連帯|れんたい}→連帯：14425_rentai⟧ (solidarity, joint responsibility) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense). Describes the emotional bond of unity that forms within a group, whether a team, community, or nation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連帯感|れんたいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧ — a sense of solidarity is born
- {連帯感|れんたいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まる→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧ — the sense of solidarity deepens
- {連帯感|れんたいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ — to strengthen the sense of solidarity
- {連帯感|れんたいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ — to feel solidarity
